notes:
Batch S (cetirizine, levocetirizine, loratadine, desloratadine, loratadine-pseudoephedrine, cetirizine-pseudoephedrine). All 284 quotes checked FOUND against the fetched text on 2026-10-17 (same normalisation as verify.mjs). BNF/BNFC not accessed (geo-blocked).
NO-UK-PRODUCT: loratadine-pseudoephedrine (clinic: Clarinase 5 mg + 120 mg) and cetirizine-pseudoephedrine (clinic: Cirrus 5 mg + 120 mg). emc search by trade name and by ingredient pair gave no results; the MHRA Products index has no SPC/PIL/PAR with either pair (every loratadine and cetirizine document lists the antihistamine alone; none of the pseudoephedrine documents lists loratadine or cetirizine). As asked, MHRA decongestant advice is included for both, as section items only: MHRA DSU 20 Feb 2024 (PRES/RCVS; contraindicated in severe or uncontrolled hypertension or severe renal disease; short-term use only) and SPS/BUMPS advice to avoid decongestants in pregnancy. The validator forbids rules on no-uk-product medicines, so none of this is an engine rule. INTEGRATOR DECISION if engine rules are wanted: the closest UK pseudoephedrine product is a 120 mg prolonged-release capsule SPC (MHRA products, PL 02855/0084, https://mhraproducts4853.blob.core.windows.net/docs/db62f39b006f7866bc9c97475990292a21a1380a): 4.3 severe/uncontrolled hypertension, severe kidney disease, severe heart disease, MAOIs within 2 weeks, other sympathomimetics; 4.4 caution in mild-moderate hypertension, heart disease, arrhythmias, diabetes, hyperthyroidism, phaeochromocytoma, glaucoma, prostatic enlargement; 4.5 tricyclics, beta-blockers, methyldopa. A generic UK pseudoephedrine 60 mg tablet SPC (PL 55612/0015, https://mhraproducts4853.blob.core.windows.net/docs/4858aa787bd38aedeb5cf6eabb6150d606d11975) is stricter: its 4.3 also contraindicates beta-blockers, diabetes mellitus, phaeochromocytoma, hyperthyroidism and closed-angle glaucoma. Neither SPC was used in the data. Both combinations are members of group sympathomimetic (sourced from the DSU sentence naming fixed-dose combinations with antihistamines), so other medicines' group:sympathomimetic rules will reach them; duplication with single loratadine/cetirizine works through ingredients.
CONFLICTS BETWEEN UK SOURCES (kept as separate items/rules): (1) Loratadine pregnancy: SmPC "preferable to avoid" (rule avoid) vs BUMPS "can be used" and SPS "preferred antihistamine" (separate info rule). (2) Loratadine breastfeeding: SmPC "not recommended" (rule avoid) vs SPS preferred choice, use with caution and infant monitoring (separate caution rule). (3) Cetirizine renal: the two UCB SmPCs (tablet, 1 mg/ml solution) use eGFR (under 15 contraindicated; 15 to under 30: 5 mg every 2 days; 30 to under 60: 5 mg daily); the Pinewood 5 mg/5 ml solution SmPC uses CrCl (under 10 contraindicated; under 30: 5 mg every 2 days; 30-49: 5 mg daily). Both sets kept as separate rules, the CrCl set limited to the oral solution formulation. (4) Cetirizine oral solution youngest age differs: UCB 1 mg/ml solution (emc 6752) from 2 years; UCB children's solution (emc 14455, not used) from 6 years; Pinewood from 2 years (2-5 years: seasonal rhinitis only, 5 mg daily). Cetirizine pregnancy (SmPC caution, BUMPS can be used, SPS preferred) agree in direction and share one caution rule.
SMPC CHOICE: cetirizine tablets from emc 6751 (pharmacy pack, 2023; the GSL pack emc 175 says "GFR" instead of eGFR); cetirizine oral solution from emc 6752 plus emc 4568 for the CrCl table and dose differences; emc 14455 read but not used.
INTERACTIONS MAPPED: cetirizine and levocetirizine with group:cns-depressant (info: SmPC states additive loss of alertness, no action); loratadine with group:cyp3a4-inhibitor and group:cyp2d6-inhibitor (info: SmPC states higher levels and possible more adverse events, no action; ketoconazole/erythromycin gave no clinically significant change). Note: group cyp2d6-inhibitor has no members defined in any batch yet. NOT MAPPED (not in master list): theophylline, ritonavir, cimetidine, antipyrine, glipizide. Desloratadine: no interaction with any master-list medicine stated.
AGE RULES at info level: loratadine under 2 years and desloratadine under 12 years (SmPC says only "not established", no action).
GROUPS ADDED: antihistamine (cetirizine, levocetirizine, loratadine, desloratadine; SmPC 5.1 lines); NEW group piperazine-antihistamine (cetirizine, levocetirizine; SmPC 5.1 "piperazine derivatives"), used for the 4.3 piperazine cross-hypersensitivity rules (hydroxyzine is not in the master list); sympathomimetic (the two combinations).
NOT FOUND: no BUMPS leaflet for levocetirizine, desloratadine or pseudoephedrine alone (the decongestant URL now holds the colds-and-flu leaflet, used); SPS antihistamine breastfeeding page does not cover levocetirizine or desloratadine; no SPS monitoring pages; no MHRA DSU specific to cetirizine, levocetirizine, loratadine or desloratadine.
NEW CONDITIONS: none. Reused: prostatic-hypertrophy, galactose-intolerance-lactase-deficiency, hereditary-fructose-intolerance, severe-renal-impairment (earlier batches), epilepsy (vocab).
Brand-specific prescribing: none stated by any accessed UK source.
AUDIT 2026-10-17 (second checker, see scripts/medcheck-uk/audit/R-S.md): content confirmed against the SmPCs, SPS and BUMPS pages; no rule changes. Section notes no longer cite emc product numbers (display text rule). Group cyp2d6-inhibitor now has members from other batches (sertraline, fluoxetine, escitalopram, duloxetine, celecoxib), so the loratadine CYP2D6 info rule now fires for them. No UK fixed-dose loratadine/pseudoephedrine or cetirizine/pseudoephedrine product re-confirmed on emc and the MHRA Products index (no SPC with either pair). Desloratadine is not added to qt-prolonging: QT prolongation appears only as a post-marketing report of unknown frequency in 4.8, 5.1 reports no QTc prolongation at 45 mg daily, and the SPS QT list does not name it.
